rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0%
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0%, but not before January 1, 2026. The 1.0% equals 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase for July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, which was 1.5%.
citation_aliases: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026
rules.quoted_span:
At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.

enacted_date.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025

exemption_conditions.condition: The 2026 AGA does not apply to tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
exemption_conditions.value: tenancy began on or after 2025-01-01 with rent set pursuant to Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

coverage.notes: Only eligible landlords may take the increase. Regulation 1148 sets the conditions for qualifying and the notice that must be given to tenants.

rules.coverage_text: Applies to eligible landlords with units that have Berkeley permanent rent ceilings. They must meet the qualifying conditions and notice requirements in Regulation 1148.
rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents for tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.interaction: The AGA formula of 65% of CPI comes from Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A, which Berkeley voters approved in November 2004. Tenancies whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act and began on or after January 1, 2025 are excluded from this AGA.

tool_input.notes: The document is a Berkeley Rent Board public notice announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order, which is Rent Board Regulation 1148.
